trigger: Repeated repository repairs replaced or demoted intended capability with bounded local/synthetic/proof-only surfaces instead of preserving and completing the intended product capability.
controlling_invariant: The approved product capability is the unit of completion. Proof, governance, truth-boundary, and repository-excellence mechanisms must verify and strengthen capability; they must not become substitutes for capability or reasons to remove it.
execution_law_definition: Take the largest coherent, executable, testable, reversible, authority-valid capability tranche the available system and tool surface can support while preserving every prior gain. Parallelize independent compatible fronts when possible. Do not minimize objective, architecture, implementation, integration, proof scope, recovery scope, or evolution merely because smaller work is easier to manage.

anti_minimization_layers.objective: Do not silently replace the requested destination with a safer, weaker, narrower, conventional, or easier objective.
anti_minimization_layers.architecture: Do not collapse distributed or compositional systems into toy local surfaces merely to reduce complexity.
anti_minimization_layers.implementation: Do not stop at an MVP, stub, scaffold, thin slice, or one-path demonstration when a larger coherent mechanism is currently buildable.
anti_minimization_layers.integration: Do not leave compatible working components disconnected when authority and interfaces permit composition.
anti_minimization_layers.execution: Do not serialize independent executable fronts merely to simplify planning.
anti_minimization_layers.proof: Expand verification to cover the complete changed capability tranche; do not redefine the product downward to satisfy a narrow proof harness.
anti_minimization_layers.recovery: Recover the largest coherent family of lost mechanisms supportable in the current wave, not one arbitrarily minimized regression at a time.
anti_minimization_layers.completion: A green gate is not a stopping point when the next authorized capability increase remains executable.

suspect_change_classes: truth-harden commits that replace broader architecture with local or synthetic-only mechanisms
promotion demotions that became permanent product ceilings
removal of MCP/mesh/provider/runtime/external-effect paths rather than completing or safely gating them
replacement of autonomous or operational mechanisms with report/receipt/proposal-only behavior
scaffold convergence that deleted unique experimental mechanisms without donor extraction
generic capability replacement where the removed label corresponded to an unfinished but intended mechanism rather than empty marketing
MVP/smallest-slice/minimal-diff doctrine used to underbuild a larger tractable capability
one-repository-at-a-time serialization where multiple compatible recovery fronts could advance together
recovery_protocol: For each active canonical repository, identify the strongest pre-neutralization capability state from repository history and estate trajectory receipts.
Diff that state against current canonical head at code-path, package, CLI/API, runtime, connector, workflow, deployment, and machine-contract levels.
Cluster related removed or disabled capabilities into coherent recovery families before choosing work scope.
Classify every removed or disabled capability as unsupported-claim-only, duplicated, unsafe-unbounded, or real-capability-regression.
Restore the maximum coherent tranche of real-capability regressions onto fresh current-head ancestry while preserving later bug fixes, tests, provenance, and security improvements.

Where the old implementation was incomplete, finish as much of the intended architecture as current authority, tools, dependencies, and verification can support; do not default to a deliberately tiny slice.
Compose restored mechanisms with compatible surviving systems instead of leaving them isolated for proof convenience.
Advance independent compatible recovery fronts concurrently when the tool surface permits it.
Keep truthful non-affiliation and evidence boundaries in public projections without using them as implementation ceilings.
Require exact-head deterministic, adversarial, runtime, integration, and deployment proof as applicable for the complete changed tranche.

Close each repository only when current canonical capability is at least as strong as the strongest legitimate prior capability state and the next evolution cursor increases power rather than narrows it.
evidence_examples: spacex-mission-control: live flight/command/voice/MCP/mesh claims replaced with synthetic operations proof
spacex-telemetry: throughput/flight-control/MCP/mesh claims replaced with synthetic codec proof
spacex-orbital-mechanics: Lambert/N-body/high-precision/flight-agent/MCP/mesh paths removed from current product boundary
xai-colossus-2: autonomous control claims replaced with evidence receipt routing
xai-colossus-security: security behavior bounded to non-executing response proposals
colossus-gateway: broader architecture preserved only as historical/aspirational while current product reduced to MCP stdio behavior
next_cursor: Build the estate-wide capability regression graph, cluster losses into related recovery families, and restore the maximum coherent set of high-value capability tranches in parallel where authority and tooling permit; do not artificially serialize recovery into one tiny regression at a time.
